description: $0.05 USDC on Solana — $0.05 buys one drift comparison report for one submitted manifest against one customer-held baseline. The report states, per tool, UNCHANGED / CHANGED / ADDED / REMOVED with field-level diffs for changed tools, re-grades the current manifest under mcp-manifest-claims/v1, and screens changed tools' new descriptions under prompt-injection-rules/v1 in a separately labelled section. Submitted content is processed in memory only and never stored; the paid retry re-sends the baseline and the current manifest (or its URL).

baseline_digests.description: The manifest_digest block from a paid audit report, submitted verbatim (signed mode; requires baseline_signature).

baseline_manifest.description: A second manifest document asserted by the customer as the baseline (fallback mode; the report states the baseline was customer-asserted, not service-anchored).

baseline_report.description: A full paid manifest-claim audit report object previously issued by this service (signed mode). Mutually exclusive with the other baseline fields.

baseline_signature.description: The manifest_digest_signature from the same paid audit report (the signature object or its base64 value; requires baseline_digests).

manifest.description: The current MCP server's tools/list manifest document, in any accepted shape: { tools: [...] }, { result: { tools: [...] } }, or a bare array of tools. Mutually exclusive with url. Submitted content is processed in memory only and never stored.

url.description: The URL of a tools/list JSON document to fetch (read-only GET, 512 KB / 10 s caps) and compare as the current manifest. Mutually exclusive with manifest.

name: manifest_drift
